column1: # Packet field layouts, one row per field. Read by `seihai capture`; overridable with --tables DIR.
# encoding: gchar gshort gint3 gint4 gint5 halftile (GCHAR/2 tiles) gstring (GCHAR length + bytes)
#   gstring_list (repeated gstring) text (rest of payload as text) comma (comma text) props (prop stream)
#   showimg (the image-record text of ids 24 and 32, decoded by the trace decoder)
# from/to: inclusive version labels, - = not limited by the table. status: known partial unknown
# Sources: Graal_analysis decomp-findings plo_layouts (2.17, 2.22, 2.31), 2.05 notes, lab captures.
